chapter: Setting the record straight on Hendersonia
title: Dunbar Palace versus Rockland, and Bobby Ysaguirre and Manzie Johnson
summary: His 1931 band played the Dunbar Palace, not Rockland; Joe Smith never played with him, bassist Bobby Ysaguirre briefly did before Fletcher, and drummer Manzie Johnson was Fats Waller's drummer.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
